name: plan
description: Answer a question with empirical proof instead of source-reading alone. /plan:research fans out to a read-only researcher (facts with file:line citations), the main thread drafts falsifiable hypotheses, and a proover writes runnable artifacts under tmp/a/<slug>/ that try to DISPROVE each one; the answer tags every claim PROVEN, DISPROVED, INCONCLUSIVE, READ-ONLY or ASSUMPTION. Every proof carries a proof.json contract (run line, cases with expected values), and plan-research.sh --verify re-runs it with exit 0 match, 1 regression, 2 execution failure, 3 no contract, recording the tree and contract hashes per run, so a 'fixed' claim can quote a re-run instead of a reading. plan-research.sh runs the same pipeline headless, so a second agent (Codex in a peer-chat pane, a CI job) can ask for a proof and read the artifacts. Project tooling comes from a committed .plan.json.
